title: Ports and relationship kinds: Library catalog
prompt: Model a Library system with two containers: a "Web Portal" (technology of your choice) and a "Catalog API" written in Rust. The Catalog API exposes a port named `catalog` for its REST interface, with protocol "HTTPS/JSON"; the Web Portal calls the API through that port. The Catalog API reads and writes to a "Database" container (technology PostgreSQL) over a synchronous relationship. Mark the Catalog API's status as `implemented`. Run `structurizrx validate --strict` before you consider it done.
